edges.reason: tx.origin is used directly to index _holderLastTransferTimestamp and enforce one purchase per block during launch
msg.sender flows through _msgSender into _transfer accounting and fee logic
block.timestamp is written into lastLpBurnTime in enableTrading
block.timestamp compared against lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency to trigger auto LP burn on transfer
block.timestamp used as the router swap deadline in swapTokensForEth
block.timestamp used as the router liquidity deadline in addLiquidity
block.timestamp written into lastLpBurnTime in autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens
block.timestamp used in manual burn cooldown check and written to lastManualLpBurnTime
_transfer invokes swapBack which performs external calls and ETH transfers before final super._transfer
_transfer may invoke autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens which makes an external pair.sync call mid-transfer
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH are available
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call
swapBack sends ETH to devWallet via low-level call, enabling reentrant state changes
swapBack sends the remaining balance to marketingWallet via low-level call, enabling reentrancy
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync after burning LP tokens
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync after burning LP tokens
_transfer reads and sets the swapping guard around swapBack
_transfer reads tradingActive to gate early transfers
_transfer reads limitsInEffect to gate anti-whale checks
_transfer reads transferDelayEnabled to gate the one-purchase-per-block rule
_transfer reads and writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp keyed by tx.origin
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buys and sells
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells
_transfer enforces maxWallet on buys and plain transfers
_transfer compares contract balance against swapTokensAtAmount
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide fee exemption
_transfer reads _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount to skip limits
_transfer applies buyTotalFees to buy fee calculation
_transfer applies sellTotalFees to sell fee calculation
_transfer accumulates fee portion into tokensForLiquidity
_transfer accumulates fee portion into tokensForMarketing
_transfer accumulates fee portion into tokensForDev
_transfer reads lastLpBurnTime for the auto burn schedule
_transfer reads lpBurnEnabled to decide auto LP burn
_transfer uses uniswapV2Pair to exclude it from transfer delay logic
_transfer indirectly mutates _balances through super._transfer
swapBack reads and resets tokensForLiquidity
swapBack reads and resets tokensForMarketing
swapBack reads and resets tokensForDev
swapBack caps the contract balance using swapTokensAtAmount
swapBack forwards remaining ETH to marketingWallet
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet
swapBack indirectly uses uniswapV2Router through swap/liquidity helpers
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes lastLpBurnTime
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses percentForLPBurn to size the burn
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the pair balance and burns from the pair
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads and writes lastManualLpBurnTime
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens enforces manualBurnFrequency cooldown

enableTrading sets tradingActive to true
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true
enableTrading initialises lastLpBurnTime to block.timestamp
removeLimits sets limitsInEffect to false
disableTransferDelay sets transferDelayEnabled to false
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount

updateMaxWalletAmount multiplies owner input by 1e18 when writing maxWallet
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount
updateSwapEnabled writes swapEnabled
updateBuyFees sums fee components into buyTotalFees
updateSellFees sums fee components into sellTotalFees
excludeFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFees
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes automatedMarketMakerPairs

updateDevWallet writes devWallet

setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled

manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens burns pair tokens through super._transfer
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router for the swap and approval
addLiquidity uses uniswapV2Router for liquidity and approval
swapBack stores the low-level call result in success without reverting
Owner check for enableTrading depends on the caller address
